evidence: Old immutable proxy image e637064c… has github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.3.2.

Application exploitation is not established by package presence.
findings.recommended_next_step: Apply supported pinned module update; verify resolved graph, actual binary and HTTPS/internal CA compatibility, then rescan old/new together.
